tweets: When a withdrawal function lacks authorization checks, any caller can trigger the transfer.
The root cause is often omitting access control logic before the Ether moves.
Implementing msg.sender checks against a stored owner prevents unauthorized triggers.
Using onlyOwner modifiers ensures only designated parties can initiate withdrawals.
Without these controls, the contract's balance becomes vulnerable to external calls.
Auditors should verify that every transfer path includes explicit access restrictions.
